CHRB official board transcript explicitly documents Cushion Track installations at Hollywood Park and Santa Anita; retain as US/California historical synthetic-surface terminology.
Generic Jump conflates Jump racing, obstacle action and start-event language. Those meanings are already separated elsewhere; retire the unsplit seed.
Seed Hold-up horse corrected to authority-backed operational phrase Held up, used by The Jockey Club for a horse restrained in the initial stages before making ground.
Generic Bonus is too broad; authority material supports named breeder/owner bonus or premium programmes already represented by recipient-specific Concepts.
